title: How many days will it take to sort out the calculation files?
goal: Use while to repeatedly advance the workload until the number of sorting reaches the target.
summary: while checks the condition first in each round, and then decides whether to execute the loop body. When the cumulative number of boxes is lower than the target, three boxes are added in each round, and the workload of the day is recorded at the same time.
tasks: completes archiveDays(initial, target). initial is the number of sorted boxes, target is the target number of boxes, both are non-negative integers.
can sort 3 boxes in one working day. Use while to add 3 boxes and 1 day each round, returning the added days when the target is met or exceeded.
Returns the number 0 if the target has been reached initially.

example.note: A cart can deliver up to 4 boxes per trip, and 9 boxes require 3 trips. You'll know when it's finished by checking the number of boxes left.

hint: If an extra day is counted after the target is reached, check whether there is an extra equal sign in the condition. The number of sorted boxes must also be updated in each round to advance to the end condition.
